Festival Foundation & Reach

Nurturing Leaders Through Art & Intellect

Rooted in a rich legacy of Islamic ethics and modern humanities, SIBĀQ '26 transforms Kuttikattoor into a vibrant melting pot of competitive arts, creative expression, and inter-state cultural exchange.

Conducted biennially, SIBĀQ brings together promising youth from diverse educational institutions across Kerala, Karnataka, Maharashtra, West Bengal, and other Indian states. It bridges traditional sciences with contemporary mediums — spanning Arabic, English, Malayalam, Urdu, Spanish, French, visual media, debates, and literature.

"Hosted by Shamsul Huda Islamic Academy, Kuttikattoor (Est. 2016) under the Kuttikkattoor Muslim Jamaath Committee, carrying forward the visionary academic standards of Darul Huda Islamic University, Chemmad."

Competitive & Artistic Disciplines:
Arabic Calligraphy Multilingual Debates Islamic Studies Visual Arts Poetry & Literature Media Production Public Speaking Performing Arts
